items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: we three would do a Clark step like you said, the Austin Brothers does, if you ever listen to him, or Bill Robinson.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've heard of Harrison Hike.

So we three, when he would come back, we three would do a Clark step like you said, the Austin Brothers does, if you ever listen to him, or Bill Robinson. Yeah, yeah. We used to do all of these kind of things, you know. I had other little acts I would put in it. Streamline was an acrobat, and he taught me a little, you know, little tricks to the tree. I used to run up the wall, so high, three or four feet up a wall and turn around and come back down.
Did you do any jump through tumble salts or something, that kind of thing? Yeah.
